items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Jan, you know, Rodgers used to have his siesta...

ctx.x: And they got many more going up. They're putting them all over, all over the city, and roads leading to all country parts.

Well, Jan, you know, Rodgers used to have his siesta and rest his self, you know, for this time of the evening. And I think he told us about all he can remember. Yeah. It's really nice. And different habitants in New Orleans, you know.
One thing, Rodgers, I wanted to ask you for the record, for history. Exactly what was the date of your birth?
